ov: A medium-sized North American wild cat with tufted ears and the short, "bobbed" tail that gives it its name. It is adaptable, living in woods, semi-desert, swamps and the edges of towns, and is territorial and mostly solitary.

why.dg: It keeps out of sight, and attacks on people happen only on rare occasions.
why.ac: Mostly nocturnal, and often out at dusk as well.

rg: From southern Canada through most of the United States to Oaxaca in Mexico.
df: Prefers rabbits and hares; also rodents, birds, insects and sometimes deer.
fx: It can take prey up to eight times its own weight.
When chased by a dog, a bobcat usually climbs a tree.
